name: PIR
summary: Italy's individual savings plan. Invest mainly in Italian companies and, after 5 years, gains are tax-free.

rules.name: Client is an Italian tax resident
rules.message: A PIR can only be held by an Italian tax resident. Client residency: {tax_residency}.
rules.explain: PIR benefits are reserved for individuals resident in Italy.

rules.name: One PIR per holder
rules.message: This client already holds a PIR ({existing}).
rules.explain: Each investor may hold a single ordinary PIR.

rules.name: Annual contribution limit
rules.message: This deposit exceeds the PIR annual contribution limit.
rules.explain: Contributions to a PIR are capped at €40,000 per calendar year.

rules.name: Lifetime contribution limit
rules.message: This deposit exceeds the PIR lifetime contribution limit.
rules.explain: Total PIR contributions are capped at €200,000.

rules.name: Single-issuer concentration ≤ 10%
rules.explain: No more than 10% of a PIR may be invested in a single issuer (or its group).

rules.name: Sufficient cash in the plan
rules.message: Not enough cash in the plan. Required {required}, available {available}.
rules.explain: Purchases and withdrawals must be covered by cash held inside the wrapper.

rules.name: ≥ 70% in Italian companies
rules.message: Only {actual_pct}% is invested in Italian companies (minimum {min_pct}%).
rules.explain: At least 70% of the plan must be invested in companies resident in Italy.

rules.name: ≥ 17.5% outside the FTSE MIB
rules.message: Only {actual_pct}% is invested in Italian companies outside the FTSE MIB (minimum {min_pct}%).
rules.explain: 25% of the qualifying 70% (17.5% of the plan) must be outside the FTSE MIB.

rules.name: 5-year holding period
rules.message: The plan is {plan_age} years old. Gains withdrawn before year 5 lose the exemption.
rules.explain: Investments must be held for 5 years for gains to be exempt.

schedule.label: Before 5 years
schedule.note: Requirements not met: 26% ordinary capital-gains tax on the gain portion.
